title: 第38章 写得好者，为状元！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: &翌日，殿试正式开始。一大早，唐敬便带着颜霜玉和唐浩夫妻俩，去唐画的院里忙里忙外。单单是衣服，都足足试了一百多套才选定，发冠，鞋，发髻，都是一套一套地试过之后，才搭配起来的。足足耗时两个时辰，唐画才穿戴整齐。此时天已经亮了，站在院中手持折扇的唐画俊美飘逸，公子无双。“哎哟，不愧是我儿，单单是这气质，皇宫大殿中，就不会有人是我儿的对手。”颜霜玉眼角含泪，激动道：“今日的新科状元，定然是属于我儿子的，对吧，老爷？”唐敬也对唐画的这身装扮很满意，笑着点头道：“画儿是我亲自教出来的，他的才华，自然能艳绝天下，力压天下文人。”“走吧，今日为父，带你夺状元去！”唐画挑了挑唇，看向西院的目光有些玩味，道：“爹，要不要和小逸说一声？”“不用了，等你夺得状元，回来再邀请他参加庆功吧！”唐敬嘴角笑容收敛，唐逸那张嘴太毒，他可不想唐逸影响到唐画。然而，一夜了，唐家却没有人发现，唐逸和唐音不在家！……皇宫，御书房。炎文帝刚刚换好了朝服，便召见了宁川。他已经迫不及待想要知道监牢的情况。“昨晚唐逸和萧棣相处如何？萧棣那小子，有没有将唐逸打服……嗯，收服？”炎文帝嘴角带笑，他对萧棣这个儿子也是很喜欢的，他性格洒脱，有主见有想法，只是自幼在外长大，江湖气有点重。不过，收服唐逸这小子，应该不是太难。结果，炎文帝却看到宁川跪在地上，面色很怪异，欲言又止。炎文帝心头忽然升起了一种不好的预感，道：“怎么？出现了意外？萧棣没将唐逸收服？”宁川不敢隐瞒，连忙拱手道：“回陛下，臣觉得……不是四殿下收服了唐逸，是唐逸收服了四殿下。”宁川将昨晚所看到的说了一遍。炎文帝：“？？?”这也能行？炎文帝沉吟了半晌，叹气，哎，没一个中用的。不过他确实失策了，没考虑到老四对高阳的宠溺，更没想到，唐逸那小子竟然敢直呼他大名，为自己背书……“陛下，昨日唐逸入狱时，还帮锦衣卫甄选出了一名北狄间谍。”虽然不爽唐逸，但宁川并没有打压他的功劳。“北狄间谍？这小子还有这种本事？”炎文帝也有些无语，这家伙还真是到哪里都不闲着啊！宁川拱手道：“陛下，已经审讯过了，这是供词。”宁川从袖中取出供词，递给了陈貂寺：“此人名为吴勇，是大炎背叛者，是北狄可汗身侧伺候的奴隶，靠自己的本事成了北狄可汗最信任的人之一。”“这次他潜入大炎，就是为了随时掌控大炎的动向。”“还有……审讯中，臣拿到了一条未经证实的消息，事关重大，还请陛下决断。”“嗯？”炎文帝原本对间谍并不在意，大炎和北狄肯定会打上一场，互派间谍试探很正常。但听到宁川的话，他意识到事情恐怕没那么简单。从陈貂寺手中接过供词，炎文帝看完之后，眉头不由皱了起来：“北狄和东虞勾结，企图吞并大炎北境？”“这不可能！大炎和东虞刚刚签订互不侵犯盟约，负责签订盟约的丞相还没回到大炎，东虞怎么可能和北狄勾结在一起？”炎文帝并不相信，东虞和大炎之间的各类盟约虽然是丞相赵桧前往边境签订，可推动这件事的是他和东虞皇帝。这对炎文帝来说，是拿得出手的政绩，只要丞相回到京都，就能昭告天下。这将会成为他炎文帝的高光时刻！现在却说签订盟约是假？东虞在明修栈道暗度陈仓？企图和北狄联手瓜分大炎？“嗯？是不是唐逸那兔崽子搞的鬼？”炎文帝冷哼，当初唐逸也有这样的见解。只是话刚出口，炎文帝就先自己否决了，要说丞相或者朝中有权有势的大臣做的，那还说得过去。唐逸，那小子现在还没这本事。“去，将那名间谍叫来见朕，朕要亲自审问。”炎文帝没有偏听偏信，立即让宁川回去提人，他要亲审。这件事后果太严重了，不能有半点马虎。一刻钟后，炎文帝来到了资政殿。经过刚才一事，炎文帝心情极坏，看到笑逐颜开的满朝文武，以及那些参与点事的甲榜仕子，心头别提多不爽了！尤其见唐敬父子二人还在其中享受众人恭维，他心头更是火起。群臣和殿试士子行了礼，炎文帝冷冷道：“今日不论政，只论殿试。”“之前，小诗仙一首《满江红》写的慷慨激昂，让朕决定不再对北狄退让。”“然，诸卿却还是觉得该与北狄和谈，以至于朕圣旨下达，兵部整顿兵马懈怠，户部整理物资消极。”“很好，朕给你们这个机会！”炎文帝站了起来，目光扫过全场。所有人大臣触及他的目光，几乎都下意识地低下头，不敢和他对视。炎文帝冷哼一声，道：“今日殿试……朕的题目便是，朕和北狄开战了，会怎么样？”“就以这为主旨，写一首诗或者词。”“写得好者，为状元！”听到这话，群臣脸色顿时都变了，大殿上顿时响起了窸窸窣窣的议论声。“什么？怎么能以此为题？”“陛下这是在为难我们，还是在为难那些甲榜士子？”“陛下怎能如此不公，臣不服！”群臣激愤。然而炎文帝摆明了，就是在发泄不满。兵部备战不勤，户部备战懈怠，已经将皇帝给激怒了。今日要是写不出一篇劝谏的好诗词，事情恐怕没那么容易结束了。而且，还得是一首堪比《满江红》的诗词才行！这就为难人了，连他们都做不到，更别说这些初出茅庐的甲榜士子了。唐敬也是面色难看，只觉得皇帝过分了。《满江红》那种诗词，天下有几人能写得出来？“陛下，臣……”唐敬下意识站了出来，想要反驳。炎文帝一个冷眼看了过去。老东西，纵容儿子虐待女儿，朕还没和你清算，你还敢废话。唐敬触及炎文帝的死亡眼神，身体一僵，后面的话当场改了口。“陛下圣明，臣无半点异议……”
content_en: &The next day, the palace examination officially began.Early in the morning, Tang Jing took Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hao to work in Tang Hua's courtyard.For the clothes alone, I had to try on more than a hundred sets before I selected them. Hair crowns, shoes, and buns were all tried on one by one before they were matched together.It took a full two hours for Tang Hua to get dressed.It was already dawn, and the Tang Hua standing in the courtyard holding a folding fan was handsome and elegant, an unparalleled gentleman."Oh, you are indeed my son. With this temperament alone, there will be no one in the palace who can be my son's opponent." Yan Shuangyu said with tears in her eyes, "Today's new top scholar must belong to my son, right, sir?" Tang Jing was also very satisfied with Tang Hua's outfit. He nodded with a smile and said: "I personally taught Hua'er, and his talent is naturally stunning."Let's go, I will take you to win the first prize today!"Tang Hua raised his lips, looked at Xiyuan with a playful look, and said, "Dad, do you want to tell Xiao Yi?""No, I will invite him to the celebration when you get the first prize!"Tang Jing's smile faded, Tang Yi's mouth was too vicious, and he didn't want Tang Yi to affect Tang Hua.However, after one night, no one in the Tang family noticed that Tang Yi and Tang Yin were not at home!...The palace, the royal study.Emperor Yanwen had just changed into his court clothes and summoned Ning Chuan.He couldn't wait to know what was going on in the prison."How did Tang Yi and Xiao Di get along last night? Did Xiao Di, that boy, conquer Tang Yi... um, subdue him?" Emperor Yanwen smiled. He also liked Xiao Di's son very much. He had a free and easy personality, had strong opinions and ideas, but he grew up outside and had a bit of a charlatan attitude.However, it shouldn't be too difficult to subdue this guy Tang Yi.As a result, Emperor Yanwen saw Ning Chuan kneeling on the ground with a strange look on his face, and he hesitated to speak.Emperor Yanwen suddenly had a bad premonition in his heart, and said: "What? There was an accident? Didn't Xiao Di subdue Tang Yi?" Ning Chuan did not dare to hide it, and hurriedly said: "Your Majesty, I feel...it was not His Highness Tang Yi who subdued Tang Yi, but Tang Yi who subdued His Highness Four." Ning Chuan told what he saw last night.Emperor Yanwen: "???" Is this possible?Emperor Yanwen pondered for a long time and sighed, alas, none of them are useful.However, he did make a mistake. He did not take into account the doting of the fourth child on Gao Yang, and he did not expect that Tang Yi would dare to call him by his first name and endorse himself... "Your Majesty, when Tang Yi was imprisoned yesterday, he helped Jin Yi Wei select a Beidi spy." Although he was unhappy with Tang Yi, Ning Chuan did not take credit for suppressing him."Beidi spy? Does this kid still have such ability?" Emperor Yan Wen was also speechless. This guy is really not idle anywhere!Ning Chuan cupped his hands and said, "Your Majesty, it has been interrogated. This is the confession." Ning Chuan took out the confession from his sleeve and handed it to Chen Diao Si: "This person's name is Wu Yong. He is a betrayer of Dayan and a slave serving Beidi Khan. He has become one of Beidi Khan's most trusted people by his own ability." "This time he hid in secret.The purpose of joining Dayan is to control Dayan's movements at any time."Also... during the interrogation, I got an unconfirmed piece of information, which is of great importance, and I would like to ask Your Majesty to make a decision.""Huh?"Emperor Yan Wen didn't care about spies at first. It's normal for Dayan and Beidi to have a fight.But after hearing Ning Chuan's words, he realized that things might not be that simple.After taking the confession from Chen Diaosi, Emperor Yanwen couldn't help but frowned after reading it: "Beidi and Dongyu colluded to try to annex the northern territory of Dayan?" "This is impossible! Dayan and Dongyu have just signed a non-aggression covenant, and they are responsible for signing the covenant.The prime minister has not returned to Dayan, how could Dongyu collude with Beidi?" Emperor Yan Wen did not believe that although the various covenants between Dongyu and Dayan were signed by Prime Minister Zhao Hui at the border, it was he and Emperor Dongyu who promoted this matter.For Emperor Yanwen, this was an impressive political achievement. As long as the prime minister returned to Kyoto, he could tell the world.This will be his highlight moment as Emperor Yanwen!Now you say the signing of the covenant was a lie?Dongyu is building a plank road in the open and hiding in Chencang?Are you trying to join forces with Beidi to carve up Great Yan?"Huh? Is it the fault of that bastard Tang Yi?" Emperor Yan Wen snorted coldly. Tang Yi also had this opinion at the beginning.But as soon as the words came out, Emperor Yanwen vetoed it himself. If it were said to be done by the prime minister or a powerful minister in the court, it would be justified.Tang Yi, that kid doesn't have this ability yet."Go and call the spy to see me. I want to interrogate him personally." Emperor Yan Wen did not listen to partial beliefs and immediately asked Ning Chuan to go back and pick up the spy. He wanted to interrogate him personally.The consequences of this matter are too serious, and we cannot afford to be careless.A quarter of an hour later, Emperor Yanwen arrived at Zizheng Hall.After what happened just now, Emperor Yanwen was in a very bad mood. Seeing the smiling faces of the civil and military officials of the court, as well as those top officials who participated in some things, he felt very unhappy!Especially when he saw Tang Jing and his son enjoying the compliments from everyone, he felt even more angry.The ministers and the palace examiners saluted, and Emperor Yanwen said coldly: "There is no politics today, only the palace examination." "Previously, the impassioned poem "Man Jiang Hong" written by Xiao Shixian made me decide not to make concessions to Beidi." "However, everyone.However, Qing still felt that peace should be negotiated with Beidi, so after my imperial edict was issued, the Ministry of War was slack in rectifying the troops, and the Ministry of Household was passive in organizing supplies."Very good, I will give you this opportunity!"Emperor Yanwen stood up and looked across the audience.When all the ministers caught his gaze, they almost lowered their heads subconsciously, not daring to look at him.Emperor Yanwen snorted coldly and said: "Today's palace examination... My topic is, what will happen if I go to war with Beidi?" "Write a poem or lyrics with this as the main theme." "The one who writes well will be the number one scholar!" After hearing this, the expressions of the ministers suddenly changed, and rustling discussions suddenly rang out in the hall."What? How can you use this as a topic?" "Is Your Majesty trying to embarrass us, or are you trying to embarrass those first-class scholars?" "How can Your Majesty be so unfair and refuse to submit?" The ministers were furious.However, Emperor Yanwen made it clear that he was venting his dissatisfaction.The Ministry of War was not diligent in preparing for war, and the Ministry of Household was slack in preparing for war, which had already angered the emperor.If I can't write a good poem of remonstrance today, I'm afraid things won't end so easily.Moreover, it has to be a poem comparable to "Man Jiang Hong"!This is difficult for people, even they can't do it, let alone these fledgling first-class scholars.Tang Jing also looked ugly, feeling that the emperor had gone too far."Manjiang
title_en: Chapter 38: Those who write well will be the top scorer!
